title: HVGERP Local Test Host
limitations: Local fixture with real AppBridge and built iframe, not ERPNext production.
Setup request timed out during manual staging; exploratory record retained.
Board reads can time out between batches and focus may request extra reads; this is not a claim of one read in the whole trace.
DOM and trace are sequential observations, not atomic. Duplicate rendered Trace text is omitted when a separate parsed trace is present.
Assignment fixture recomputes the document when released; old snapshot overwrite is proven by regression tests, Browser proves serialization through the real controls.
